# ai-effect

> Use the Vercel AI SDK with Effect v4 in TypeScript applications.

The npm package is `@jambudipa/ai-effect`. Use the root entry for the `AiSdk`
service and its default layer. Use `@jambudipa/ai-effect/ai` for direct SDK
operations and `@jambudipa/ai-effect/ai/test` for model and stream fixtures.

Model calls start when the Effect runs. Stream consumption starts a request,
and closing its scope early cancels it. The first tutorials use local fixtures
and run without provider credentials.

## Start here

- [Project README](README.md): Package setup, text generation, and public imports.
- [User guide](docs/user-guide/README.md): Entry points for lessons, tasks, and the API.
- [Installation and compatibility](docs/user-guide/reference/installation.md): Supported Node.js and Effect versions, optional peers, and host requirements.

## Tutorials

- [First text result](docs/user-guide/tutorials/getting-started/first-text-result.md): Set up a project and run a fixed text request through `AiSdk`.
- [First text stream](docs/user-guide/tutorials/getting-started/first-text-stream.md): Collect text deltas from a model fixture.
- [Triage a support ticket](docs/user-guide/tutorials/generation/triage-a-support-ticket.md): Validate a model response against a schema.
- [Check a model request](docs/user-guide/tutorials/testing/check-a-model-request.md): Assert the answer, forwarded prompt, and request count in a local test.
- [All tutorials](docs/user-guide/tutorials/README.md): Lessons on generation, streaming, providers, tests, and integrations.

## Common tasks

- [Choose a provider and model](docs/user-guide/how-to/providers/choose-a-provider.md): Configure credentials and select a model handle for a request.
- [Return structured output](docs/user-guide/how-to/generation/return-structured-output.md): Use `Output.object` and read the validated result.
- [Serve a UI message response](docs/user-guide/how-to/streaming/serve-a-ui-message-response.md): Send a model response to a compatible chat client.
- [Ask for approval before a tool writes data](docs/user-guide/how-to/tools/approve-a-tool-action.md): Save the pending action and resume with the user's decision.
- [Cancel a disconnected request](docs/user-guide/how-to/reliability/cancel-a-disconnected-request.md): Pass the request's abort signal to the model call.
- [Connect an MCP client](docs/user-guide/how-to/integrations/mcp/connect-an-mcp-client.md): Open a connection and release it when the scope closes.
- [Test application requests](docs/user-guide/how-to/testing/README.md): Use model fixtures, a replacement service, or HTTP fixtures.
- [All how-to guides](docs/user-guide/how-to/README.md): Find tasks for providers, tools, streams, media, frameworks, reliability, and integrations.

## API reference

- [Reference](docs/user-guide/reference/README.md): Installation, import paths, and API contracts.
- [Import paths](docs/user-guide/reference/import-paths.md): Public subpaths and the conditions that select their implementations.
- [Core API](docs/user-guide/reference/core.md): The service layer, generation functions, result types, and errors.
- [Public declarations](docs/user-guide/reference/api/README.md): API signatures grouped by source folder.
- [Provider adapters](docs/user-guide/reference/api/providers/README.md): Model selectors, settings, and provider tools.
- [Framework adapters](docs/user-guide/reference/api/frameworks/README.md): UI bindings and host-specific entries.
- [Integration APIs](docs/user-guide/reference/api/integrations/README.md): MCP, tools, agents, Workflow, telemetry, and test servers.
